WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) as count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(count) as total_count
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    step1.observstation,
    step1.count,
    CAST(step1.count AS REAL) / step2.total_count as proportion
  FROM step1
  CROSS JOIN step2
  WHERE step2.total_count IS NOT NULL
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(proportion) as avg_proportion
  FROM step3
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT 
    step3.observstation,
    step3.count,
    step3.proportion,
    step3.proportion - step4.avg_proportion as excess
  FROM step3
  CROSS JOIN step4
  WHERE step3.proportion > step4.avg_proportion
)
SELECT 
  AVG(count) as avg_count,
  AVG(proportion) as avg_proportion,
  AVG(excess) as avg_excess
FROM step5
